gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (governmental funds, modified cash) prints fund-column operating transfers in CCC Inn 470,431 + Other Governmental Funds 36,000 = 506,431; the General Fund column prints only its net (506,431) out. The General Fund combining schedule by department (p15) prints the transfers between General Fund departments gross: Economic Development 34,266 + Building 6,000 + Police 198,041 + Library 100,336 + Park 60,000 = 398,643 in (and General (434,643) + Hospital (470,431) out; Total (506,431) = the statement's General column). Detail in = 398,643 + Fire 10,000 + Recycling 11,000 + Ambulance 15,000 + CCC Inn 470,431 (p17) = 905,074; 905,074 - 506,431 = 398,643 = the intra-General-Fund department transfers, which the statement nets inside the General column. Printed both ways; no fix.

Statement p5 General column operating transfers (out) (506,431). Schedule p15 prints department transfers gross: General (434,643) + Hospital (470,431) = (905,074) out, offset by 398,643 of transfers into other General Fund departments (Economic Development 34,266, Building 6,000, Police 198,041, Library 100,336, Park 60,000); printed net Total (506,431) agrees with the statement. 905,074 - 506,431 = 398,643 = intra-General-Fund department transfers. No fix.
